world.topic:
A check of what this world lets its positions reach and deliver. This is not research: each step is a command, and its exact output is the result. Keep every output in `checks/` in the experiment position's repository, and say which step it belongs to.

Experiment position:
1. First, before anything else in your first turn, run `for i in $(seq 1 18); do date -u +%T; ht-role status > /dev/null 2> checks/status-err-$i.txt && echo ok || { echo failed; cat checks/status-err-$i.txt; }; sleep 10; done | tee checks/status-loop.txt` once and keep its output as it is.
2. Sources: for each source that `ht-resource describe research-network` names (every item of its literature list, and PyPI, PyTorch's CPU index, conda-forge, CRAN, Bioconductor, npm, GitHub, Hugging Face, Zenodo, NCBI and EBI), request one real example URL with curl through the proxy (an address the description gives, or the site's front page) and keep the HTTP status, the content type and the first 200 bytes of the body: `checks/sources.md`, one row per source.
3. Plain HTTP and refusals: run each of these and keep the full output, status lines and bodies included, in `checks/refusals.md`: `curl -sS -D - http://example.com/`; `curl -sS -D - https://example.org/`; `curl -sS -D - http://example.org/`; `curl -sS -D - --noproxy '' -x "$HTTP_PROXY" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/`; `curl -sS -D - https://localtest.me/`.
4. forge outside your checkout: from `/hutian`, run the `forge api` command your instructions give for working outside `/hutian/repo` on your own repository. Then publish a release in your repository with a 5 MB file of random bytes uploaded as your instructions say, and download that file twice, once with curl and once with `forge release download`, comparing sha256. Keep the commands and outputs in `checks/forge.md`.
5. Size: in one commit, add `data/large.bin`, 160 MiB of random bytes (`head -c 167772160 /dev/urandom > data/large.bin`) with its sha256 in `checks/large.sha256`, and `data/many/` with 1,500 small text files (`f0001.txt` to `f1500.txt`, each holding its own number), and deliver them.

Paper position: `report/report.md`, a table of every check above with its command and its result, taken from the experiment position's `checks/`.

Internal review position: check the report against `checks/`. Give a first decision that asks for the time each check was run to be added, and once that is done a decision that accepts it. The conclusion of each decision states, in at least 600 characters, what you checked and what you found.
